request.recipient: Intersect 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor TxPipe
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Tx3 by TxPipe, described as an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols with developer and AI-agent-facing infrastructure.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Tx3 is presented as a framework where each protocol is described once with a verified interface definition that produces documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live JSON-RPC endpoints.
TxPipe has already put the Tx3 developer layer into production through Catalyst Fund 14 with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry.
The proposal funds 12 additional protocol onboardings, at 3 per quarter, plus development of an MCP server and skill framework as shared registry infrastructure.
The proposal states that there is currently no common interface mechanism across the ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and raising integration costs.
The proposal claims Cardano protocols need shared, auditable agent interfaces because hallucinated on-chain transactions can irreversibly move real assets.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission.
The requested amount is stated not to breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are stated to be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with smart-contract permissions involving Intersect admins, leadership, and an external Oversight Committee.

TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule, plus 2025 Intersect open-source maintenance funding being delivered on schedule.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for a 12-month Tx3 expansion by TxPipe, submitted through Intersect, to onboard protocols and build developer and AI-agent interface infrastructure with claimed budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract oversight.
